rosa-starter.title: Your $150 deposit from Sept. 1 was sent back
rosa-starter.body: Your bank sent it back on Sept. 3, so the money never reached First Leaf. Your investments were not touched.
rosa-starter.nextStep: Check your bank account first. Then you can try the deposit again.

rosa-starter.title: Your goal is $150 behind your plan
rosa-starter.body: You planned to put in $1,400 by now. So far $1,250 went through. This only counts deposits, not the market.
rosa-starter.nextStep: You can add a one-time deposit to catch up, or keep going as planned. Either is fine.

rosa-starter.title: $452.11 is waiting in cash
rosa-starter.body: Auto-invest has been paused since May 27, so deposits since then stay as cash. Cash does not go up or down with the market.
rosa-starter.nextStep: It is your choice. You can turn auto-invest back on, or leave it paused.

rosa-starter.title: Crypto is not covered by SIPC protection
rosa-starter.body: SIPC protection helps get back the stocks and cash in a brokerage account if the firm fails. It does not cover crypto, like your Bitcoin and Ethereum.
rosa-starter.nextStep: Nothing to do. This is just so you know.
